menu.missingHint: This folder is gone or no longer this repository.

dialog.title: Clone {{repo}}
dialog.description: Copy this repository to your computer. The folder is linked to the repository when cloning finishes.
dialog.targetHint: A folder named {{name}} is created inside the folder you choose.
dialog.protocolHint: You can change this in Settings.

blocked.offline: You’re offline, so you can’t clone right now.
blocked.session_expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to clone.
blocked.rate_limited: GitHub’s rate limit was reached. Try again later.

dialog.existsSame: It’s already a copy of this repository. You can link this folder instead of cloning.
dialog.existsOther: It isn’t a copy of this repository, so nothing was cloned. Choose another location.

cloneFailure.signed_out: You’re signed out. Sign in and try again.
cloneFailure.session_expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again and retry.
cloneFailure.offline: You’re offline. Check your connection and try again.
cloneFailure.rate_limited: GitHub’s rate limit was reached. Try again later.
cloneFailure.invalid_target: The location must be a full folder path.
cloneFailure.auth_failed: GitHub rejected the sign-in for HTTPS. Sign in again, or switch to SSH in Settings.
cloneFailure.ssh_auth: SSH authentication failed. Check your SSH key and known hosts, or switch to HTTPS in Settings.
cloneFailure.not_found: The repository doesn’t exist or you don’t have access to it.
cloneFailure.network: A network error interrupted the clone. Try again.
cloneFailure.target_error: Couldn’t create or write to the location. Choose another folder.
cloneFailure.git_error: Git reported an error while cloning.

linkFailure.not_git: That folder isn’t the top of a Git repository.
linkFailure.not_github: That folder has no remote pointing to a GitHub repository.
linkFailure.different_repo: That folder is a different repository.
linkFailure.unresolved: Couldn’t confirm which repository the folder points to. Check your connection and try again.

openFailure.missing: The folder is gone. Relink it to its new location.
openFailure.no_editor: No editor was found. Choose a default editor in Settings.
openFailure.unknown_editor: That editor isn’t installed anymore. Choose another in Settings.
